faq.label: Frequently asked questions
faq.title: What you're probably wondering
faq.subtitle: Privacy, pricing, how it works, and access: answers to what we get asked the most.

items.q: Are my documents and pricing really kept confidential?
items.a: Yes. Every organization is fully isolated: no data is visible to another client, no file is ever used to inform or benefit a competitor, and no model is trained on your data without your written consent. You can request deletion of all or part of your data within 72 hours. Full detail on our privacy page.

items.q: Is the service adapted to Moroccan legal requirements?
items.a: Yes, that's its whole purpose. Adjuja is built for Moroccan public tenders, aligned with decree n°2-22-431, and works directly on your specifications and tender rules, not a generic format imported from another country.

items.q: Why 990 MAD a month, isn't that expensive for software?
items.a: The price isn't anchored on generic software but on the cost of a consultant's working day. Three hours saved on a single file, or one avoided mistake on an eliminatory criterion, easily covers a month's subscription. The goal isn't to replace a consultant, it's to give them their time back.

items.q: Am I locked into a minimum term?
items.a: No, the plan has no minimum term and can be cancelled at any time from your dashboard.

items.q: Can I trust what the AI drafts or analyses?
items.a: Adjuja prepares, you decide. The analysis extracts criteria and deadlines to save you reading time, drafting prepares a structure and standard sections. Nothing is submitted without you reviewing, adjusting and validating every section yourself.

items.q: Does this replace my expertise or my consulting firm?
items.a: No. Adjuja removes the repetitive work, reading specifications, hunting for criteria, formatting, not professional judgment. The decision to bid on a tender and the responsibility for the submitted offer remain entirely yours.

items.q: Why a waitlist instead of instant sign-up?
items.a: We open access in waves during the pilot phase to properly support each firm joining Adjuja, rather than spreading attention too thin across too many accounts at once. Profiles closest to our target get priority.

items.q: If I run into an issue or have a question, who helps?
items.a: Our team is reachable at contact@adjuja.com. During the pilot phase, every firm gets direct support to get up and running with the service.

sections.heading: Publication manager
paragraphs: The site is published by the ADJUJA team, reachable at contact@adjuja.com for any question about its content.

sections.heading: Intellectual property
paragraphs: The ADJUJA brand, its logo, texts, interface and site structure are the property of ADJUJA, unless stated otherwise. Any reproduction, representation or use, in whole or in part, without prior written authorization is prohibited.

sections.heading: User-submitted content
paragraphs: Documents and information you upload to ADJUJA (specifications, tender files, generated documents) remain your exclusive property. Their handling is detailed in our privacy policy.

sections.heading: Applicable law
paragraphs: This site and its use are governed by Moroccan law. In the event of a dispute, and failing an amicable resolution, the competent courts of Rabat shall have sole jurisdiction.

sections.heading: Purpose of the service
paragraphs: ADJUJA helps Moroccan professionals track public tenders relevant to their business, assess whether to bid on them, and prepare their technical offers.
ADJUJA assists the professional; it does not replace their judgment or their legal responsibility as a bidder.

sections.heading: Access to the service
paragraphs: Registration is personal. During the pilot phase, access opens in waves and may require an invitation or a waitlist. ADJUJA reserves the right to prioritize certain profiles based on the pilot's needs.

sections.heading: User account
paragraphs: You are responsible for keeping your credentials confidential and for the accuracy of the information provided at registration. Any activity carried out from your account is presumed to be performed by you.

sections.heading: Permitted use
paragraphs: The service is intended for fair professional use. Prohibited uses include: automated bulk extraction of the service's content, resale or subletting of access, and using the service to harm another user's interests.

sections.heading: Liability
paragraphs: The analyses, extracted criteria and drafting suggestions generated by ADJUJA are a decision and drafting aid. You remain solely responsible for the final content submitted to the contracting authority, its compliance with the specifications, and the legal commitments that follow, notably the commitment letter and the sworn statement.

sections.heading: Pricing and billing
paragraphs: Current pricing is the one displayed on the pricing page at the time of subscription. Unless stated otherwise at the time of subscription, the plan has no minimum term and can be cancelled at any time.

sections.heading: Suspension and termination
paragraphs: ADJUJA may suspend an account in the event of abusive use of the service or non-payment, after notice by email when possible. You may terminate your account at any time from your dashboard or by simply asking at contact@adjuja.com.

sections.heading: Changes to these terms
paragraphs: These terms may evolve, notably as the service grows. Any substantial change will be notified to active users by email.

sections.heading: Applicable law and jurisdiction
paragraphs: These terms are governed by Moroccan law. In the event of a dispute, and failing an amicable resolution, the competent courts of Rabat shall have sole jurisdiction.

sections.heading: Data controller
paragraphs: ADJUJA is responsible for processing the personal data collected through this site and application. For any question, contact us at contact@adjuja.com.

sections.heading: Data collected
paragraphs: We collect the following data:
list: Identity: first name, last name, email address
Password, stored in encrypted form, never in plain text
Qualification data provided at registration: company, industry sector, number of tenders handled per year
Documents you upload for analysis (specifications, tender rules, tender files) and documents generated by the service

sections.heading: Purpose of processing
paragraphs: This data is used to create and manage your account, provide the service (monitoring, analysis, document generation), improve the product, select profiles during the pilot phase, and communicate with you about the service.

sections.heading: Legal basis
paragraphs: Processing is based on the performance of the contract formed with ADJUJA upon registration, as well as ADJUJA's legitimate interest in improving its service.

sections.heading: Retention period
paragraphs: Your data is kept for as long as your account is active, then deleted within a reasonable period after closure, unless otherwise required by law.

sections.heading: Recipients of the data
paragraphs: Your data is neither sold nor shared for commercial purposes with third parties. Only technical providers strictly necessary for the service to function (hosting, infrastructure, automated document processing) have access to it, solely to run the service.

sections.heading: Our commitments
paragraphs: Beyond our legal obligations, here are the commitments we make to you:
list: Your documents belong to you: ADJUJA claims no ownership over them.
Total isolation between organizations: no client's data is visible or accessible to another.
No competitive use of your data: ADJUJA never uses one client's file to inform or benefit another.
No model training on your data without your prior written consent.
Deletion on request within 72 hours, for all or part of your data.
Compliance with law 09-08 on the protection of individuals with regard to the processing of personal data.

sections.heading: Your rights
paragraphs: In accordance with law 09-08, you have a right of access, rectification, deletion and objection over your personal data. You can exercise these rights at any time by simply asking at contact@adjuja.com.

sections.heading: Security
paragraphs: We implement technical measures to protect your data: password encryption, data isolation per organization, and access restricted to those who need it to operate the service.

sections.heading: Cookies and local storage
paragraphs: ADJUJA uses your browser's local storage to maintain your login session. No advertising cookie or third-party tracking tool is used at this time.

sections.heading: Contact
paragraphs: For any question about your personal data or this policy, write to us at contact@adjuja.com.
